git add cmd/ethos/session.go cmd/ethos/session_harness_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(session): two PR #507 review findings on our own cluster1 fixes

A (Bugbot + a second independent reviewer). The 4pvt `unset
ETHOS_SESSION` hint fired whenever the variable was merely non-empty,
not only when it named the session `end` actually just deleted.
`session end --session A` while ETHOS_SESSION=B (a different, live
session) deleted A and told the operator to clear B -- which is still
valid and, outside Claude Code, is B's only remaining discovery
channel. Following that advice would have severed it. The same
function already has the correct condition for refusing to drop the
current-pointer in an analogous case (only touch it when it names
sid); the hint now reuses that same check instead of a bare
non-empty test.

B (invariant-completeness / Bugbot). The gu3p fix validated
--persona via identityStore().Exists(), which is only an os.Stat.
Malformed YAML, a layered-load error, a missing kind, or a kind that
is neither "human" nor "agent" all passed Exists() and still reached
the roster write -- deferring exactly the failure the bead was filed
about to a later `whoami`. Now loads the record (Reference(true),
since attribute-content resolution is irrelevant to whether the
identity itself is well-formed) and calls Identity.Validate().

Regressions for both, verified failing before the fix:
- TestSessionEnd_HintOnlyWhenEnvNamesEndedSession
- TestCLI_SessionStart_RejectsMalformedPersonaFile
- TestCLI_SessionStart_RejectsInvalidKindPersona
EOF
)"
